page.overview:
Who is Part?

Part is a member of the Bonney Pirates. He was once a resident of the Sorbet Kingdom, having been a friend of Bartholomew Kuma and Ginny since young adulthood.

After the Summit War of Marineford, he was arrested by Admiral Akainu following his crew's defeat against the Blackbeard Pirates.

Part is a tall man with very thin eyebrows and a triangle-shaped head. He keeps his hair in a tiny afro.

22 years ago, he wore a white shirt with suspenders. 3 years ago, at Bonney's birthday party, he wore a leather jacket.
